comment.body:
Thanks for the report.

This looks like the same problem as:

- #301 sync --watch crashes with ENOSPC on large folders (same `ENOSPC` file-watcher error on `sync --watch`). It was closed as fixed in 2.4.0, which falls back to polling when the watcher limit runs out, and you're on 2.3.1, so upgrading may solve it.
- #377 Watcher limit error on Fedora with many files (same error, still open).

If this is the same problem, following #301 or #377 keeps it in one place.

_Automated triage. A maintainer will follow up._
